title: Modular Grove configuration
intro: Design against the approved requirements. The grammar and resolver are specified here; implementation follows review.

groups.title: Command reuse
groups.description: Explicit routes, reusable bindings and parameterized commands.

groups.title: Composition
groups.description: Which sources contribute, and in what order.

groups.title: Validation and inspection
groups.description: One resolver supplies inspection and launch.

discussion.title: Resolve one inspectable command per kind
discussion.summary: Profiles patch named settings; includes apply before a profile's own values. Local selection replaces the default list. Direct local values apply last, over kinds explicitly routed by active personal policy.

diagrams.title: Change bindings without copying the kind map
diagrams.caption: Solid arrows are references in one resolved arrangement. Dashed arrows show which object a profile changes. The binding names and commands are user policy; Grove supplies none.

diagrams.title: Personal base, selected profiles, then local values
diagrams.caption: A data-flow view of resolution. Include expansion is depth first and repeats are reapplied. Source discovery refuses an inadmissible candidate; failure does not select a fallback.

diagrams.title: Inspection and launch share the resolved snapshot
diagrams.caption: A flowchart, not a model-checking result. All admitted routes are compiled before use. Runtime slots remain identified placeholders during inspection; only launch supplies a mandate.
